grammatical_complexity.notes: Dominated by simple present and past tenses, but passive voice appears frequently throughout (has been turned off, is being given, should be pushed, will be put up). Present perfect and first conditional appear as a noticeable minority. Complex structures are regular but not dominant.

references_found: MAID (medically assisted suicide, explained in text)
cultural_reference_load.notes: Most brand references (Tesla, Samsung, Nike) are globally known. MAID and Neuralink are explained in-text. The US healthcare/insurance cost logic is somewhat unfamiliar but contextually clear. 'Graveyard shifts' is a North American workplace term but inferable. Overall accessible to an educated LatAm adult.

sentence_structure.notes: Many short dialogue lines and simple narrative sentences. Some moderate-length sentences with subordinate clauses, particularly in the AI voice's directives. Average is kept low by frequent short dialogue exchanges.

items.context: It was the fact that she had actually asked the question against her good judgement.
items.reason: Spanish speaker may read 'actually' as 'actualmente' (currently), but the context of 'against her good judgement' helps clarify it means 'in fact/really.' Moderate trap.

items.context: His parents will be in the room with him.
items.reason: Spanish 'parientes' means relatives in general, but context (9-year-old child patient) makes it clear these are the father and mother. Not a strong trap.
